notes.key_messages: Candidates are advised to: • respond to all parts of Question 2 • use linking words in Question 2, for example when giving opinions and explanations • expand on the basic details of their responses to Question 3 • plan and organise answers into a coherent piece of writing, using extended sentences where possible.
notes.general_comments: Candidates are advised to pay particular attention to the question words and tenses used in the different tasks for Question 2 and Question 3. Candidates should aim at keeping to the recommended word count but should refrain from crossing out sentences indiscriminately if they write slightly more.
